citation.title: High time to act on enforcing lobbying rules (open letter to Commission President von der Leyen)

question: Calls on the European Commission to enforce lobbying transparency and ethics rules and protect climate policymaking from undue corporate influence.
method: None. It is an advocacy letter with no data or analysis.

findings.claim: The authors assert (without data) that the EU Transparency Register is dysfunctional, with loopholes and too little monitoring, resources and enforcement to detect undue influence.
findings.quote: the Transparency Register has proven to be dysfunctional. The register still contains large loopholes, and the lack of monitoring, resources and enforcement

findings.claim: The authors assert that the number of lobbyists and their spending are growing, and that many try to block or water down protective policies.
findings.quote: the number of lobbyists from inside and outside Europe is growing, spending ever-more money on lobbying the EU institutions

findings.claim: Recommendation (not a finding): make the register de facto mandatory, with a resourced oversight body able to investigate and sanction.
findings.quote: A functional lobbying transparency register deserving of the label of “de-factomandatory”.

findings.claim: Recommendation: extend the obligation to meet only registered lobbyists, and proactive disclosure of meetings, to all EU officials down to heads of unit.
findings.quote: The obligation to only meet with registered lobbyists should be expanded to all EU officials

findings.claim: Recommendation: protect climate and Green Deal policymaking from undue influence and policy capture by corporations, and prevent corporate dominance of advisory groups and lobby meetings.
findings.quote: Undue influence and policy capture by corporations must be prevented.

limitations.point: Two-page advocacy letter. It has no data, method or definitions of business, fossil or lobbyist categories. It concerns the EU institutions, not the UNFCCC.

reference_lists_or_datasets.name: EU Transparency Register
reference_lists_or_datasets.what_it_is: The EU lobbying register, mentioned and criticised, not analysed.
